digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 finding functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call usage attached by runner, so BatchRunResult.outputs has no usage key and per-criterion token totals are missing from coverage.metrics.
Per-criterion request counts are extracted but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions.

All three pass functions and run_focused_finder must change return type to include usage dict as a second element in a tuple, with all external callers (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval, prerequisites) updated atomically.

Usage is attributed per call with criteria coverage list; multi-criterion chunks divide token fields equally across criteria while llm_calls and requests count in full for each criterion; ladder retries each append a record, raising attempts contribute nothing.

BatchRunResult must emit output['_usage'] containing per_call records and per_criterion attribution map; sidecar payload must carry coverage.usage with those exact key names; _attach_plan_review_metrics must fold token totals into coverage.metrics.
